reason: Both sell enterprise and industrial hardware with attached software and services, through channel partners. Digi's products are IoT connectivity gear: cellular routers, console servers and embedded modules. Zebra's products are data-capture and workflow devices: mobile computers, scanners, printers and RFID. Their end markets overlap (retail, transportation, healthcare, industrial). Digi also sells to OEMs, utilities and network operators, which Zebra's evidence doesn't show. The product lines are different, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
